# Sarin Memorial Legal Aid Foundation

> > A non-profit legal aid organization dedicated to providing legal assistance, education, and international moot court competitions in service of public interest and social responsibility.

The Sarin Memorial Legal Aid Foundation is a non-profit organization based in Chandigarh, India, founded to honor Harbans Lal Sarin and Ranjit Lal Sarin. The foundation focuses on legal aid, legal literacy, and legal education through various initiatives including the prestigious Leiden-Sarin International Air Law Moot Court Competition.
